input: Find a local supper club to join this season

gold.taskTitle: Find and Join a Local Supper Club This Season
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate and become a member of a supper club in their area during the current season.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood are you searching in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to narrow the search to relevant local options.

questions.title: Which season are you hoping to start attending?
questions.description: Determine the target season so timelines and availability can be accounted for.

questions.title: Do you want to join an existing club or start one?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is looking to find an established supper club or form a new one.

questions.title: What cuisine style or dining theme interests you most?
questions.description: Understand food preferences so the search can be filtered to matching clubs.

questions.title: How often are you able to attend supper club events?
questions.description: Establish the user's availability to match clubs with compatible meeting frequencies.

questions.title: Are you looking to attend solo or bring a partner or guests?
questions.description: Determine group size expectations to find clubs that accommodate the right number of people.

questions.title: What is your budget per person for a typical dinner?
questions.description: Identify a spending range to filter out clubs that may be too costly or too casual.
